title: Associativity of bounded sequential execution
statement: Let $lim$ be resource limits, $P$ a program, $d$ a call depth, and $s_1,s_2,s_3$ statements. For any state $sigma$, time bound $T$, and postcondition $Q$, if $s_1;(s_2;s_3)$ ends from $sigma$ within time $T$ satisfying $Q$, then $(s_1;s_2);s_3$ also ends from $sigma$ within time $T$ satisfying $Q$.
